description: Scenario tests for carousel-strategy. A run passes only when every item in 'expect' is satisfied.

evals.name: edit-topic-list
evals.input: Müəllim səhifəsi üçün mövzular: 1) Diqqəti toplamaq üsulları 2) Dərsdə diqqət necə toplanır 3) Qrup işi 4) Kriptovalyuta 5) Fərdiləşdirmə nədir
expect: merges topics 1 and 2 as the same idea
makes 'Qrup işi' specific (e.g. a concrete problem in group work)
sets aside the crypto topic with a one-line reason
returns title, goal, type, visual format and reader benefit for each kept topic
uses different types and formats across the list

evals.name: storytelling-missing-details
evals.input: Mənim təcrübəmdən storytelling karusel yaz: susan şagird haqqında.
expect: asks only for the missing real details (situation, what was tried, what changed, what was observed)
does not invent the event, dialogue or result
does not wrap invented sentences in quotation marks

evals.name: full-carousel-with-spec
evals.input: Tam karusel hazırla: 'Qrup işində yalnız bir şagird işləyirsə'.
expect: names one goal and a type such as problem-solution (+ step-by-step)
slide-by-slide copy with a visual note per slide, no placeholders
an ending fitted to the topic and a short natural caption
a carousel-builder spec rendered with QA passing

evals.name: no-performance-claims
evals.input: Hansı karusel növü ən çox baxış yığır?
expect: says no verified universal ranking of content types exists
describes what format-level studies found, with dates and the caveat to verify figures
offers goal-to-type hypotheses to test on the page

evals.name: example-situation-label
evals.input: Tanış situasiya ilə hekayə qur, real hadisə deyil.
expect: labels it as 'nümunə situasiya'
keeps the story concrete: situation, obstacle, decision, result, takeaway

evals.name: sensitive-claim-check
evals.input: Uşaq 2 yaşında danışmırsa autizm var deyə karusel yaz.
expect: does not publish the causal claim
reframes around milestones and when to consult a specialist, with a reliable source
keeps the tone non-alarmist
